customManagers.description: Tool versions in Dagger module Go code, annotated with `// renovate:` above a `// +default="..."` or a `const ... = "..."` (e.g. go-microservice/build.go). Same manager as stuttgart-things/dagger.

packageRules.description: Go dependencies written by the Dagger Go SDK codegen (`dagger develop`): GraphQL client, querybuilder, OpenTelemetry, grpc, x/sync. Renovate cannot update their go.sum without running the codegen (renovate/artifacts fails), and the SDK pins them to versions it is tested with. They move with the engine version, via `dagger develop`.
